extra.message: User-controlled input from the 'name' query parameter (line 19) is passed through f-string interpolation (line 38) and then rendered by Jinja2 Template.render(). This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI). An attacker can inject template expressions like {{config}} or {{request.application.__globals__}} to access internal objects, read files, or achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: User input from the 'name' query parameter is directly interpolated into HTML content via f-string without HTML encoding or sanitization. An attacker can inject malicious JavaScript by sending a request like /?name=<script>alert('XSS')</script> which will be reflected in the response. This is a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
